# ui::TextLayout

Header: `winui/render/TextLayout.hpp`.

Paragraphs of differently styled runs broken into lines, with the geometry selection needs: the engine behind [TextControl](../controls/text.md#uitextcontrol) inlines, [RichText](../controls/rich-text.md#uirichtext) and a multi-line [TextBox](../controls/text-box.md#uitextbox).

Built only on [TextMeasurer::measure()](text-measurer.md#measure), so it lays out the same with every measurer. Lines break greedily after runs of spaces (a trailing space hangs), a word spanning runs stays whole, and under `Wrap` an overlong word is split between characters. Each piece between break opportunities is measured once and cached, so laying out again at another width measures nothing. All offsets address [text()](#text): every run's text in order, paragraphs joined by one `\n`. Mixed font sizes on one line share a bottom edge rather than a baseline.

Call order: [set_content()](#set_content), then [layout()](#layout), then the queries and [render()](#render).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::TextStyle body{.font_size = 14.0f, .horizontal = ui::TextAlign::Leading};
ui::TextStyle bold = body;
bold.weight           = ui::FontWeight::Bold;

ui::TextLayout layout; // a member of the element that shows the text
layout.set_content({
    {{{"Hello ", bold}, {"world, this wraps.", body}}},
    {{{"Second paragraph", body}}, ui::Edges{.top = 8}},
});

// In measure_override(), with the measurer it is handed:
ui::TextLayoutOptions options;
options.max_width  = 120.0f;
options.wrapping   = ui::TextWrapping::Wrap;
options.base_style = body;
layout.layout(options, measurer);

// In pointer_override():
const std::size_t caret = layout.hit_test({30.0f, 5.0f}); // click -> offset
const ui::Rect    bar   = layout.caret_rect(caret);       // where to draw the caret

// In render_override(), with the renderer it is handed:
ui::TextLayout::Paint paint;
paint.foreground = ui::colors::Black;
paint.selection  = ui::TextHighlight{0, 5, ui::colors::White, std::nullopt};
layout.render(renderer, {10.0f, 20.0f}, paint);
```

## TextLayout

```cpp
TextLayout() = default
```

Empty: no content, no lines.

## TextLayout

```cpp
TextLayout(const TextLayout& other)
```

A copy of the content and the last layout, indexing its own copy of the runs.

## operator=

```cpp
TextLayout& operator=(const TextLayout& other)
```

As the copy constructor.

## TextLayout

```cpp
TextLayout(TextLayout&&) noexcept = default
```

Moves; the runs stay where they are, so the index moves along.

## operator=

```cpp
TextLayout& operator=(TextLayout&&) noexcept = default
```

As the move constructor.

## ~TextLayout

```cpp
~TextLayout() = default
```

## set_content

```cpp
bool set_content(std::vector<TextLayoutParagraph> paragraphs)
```

Replaces the content. Measurements are kept when only colors or tags changed, and everything is kept when nothing did. Returns whether the text or its formatting changed.

## content

```cpp
const std::vector<TextLayoutParagraph>& content() const
```

The paragraphs from the last [set_content()](#set_content).

## layout

```cpp
void layout(const TextLayoutOptions& options, const TextMeasurer& measurer, std::size_t start = 0)
```

Lays the content out from [`start`](#start) (an offset into [text()](#text); an overflow container's continuation), dropping whatever came before it. A start inside a paragraph drops that paragraph's top margin.

## size

```cpp
Size size() const
```

The widest line (with its paragraph's margins) and every line's height with the margins.

## lines

```cpp
const std::vector<Line>& lines() const
```

The lines of the last [layout()](#layout), top to bottom.

## fragments

```cpp
const std::vector<Fragment>& fragments() const
```

Every drawn piece of the last [layout()](#layout), grouped per line (see [Line::fragment_begin](#struct-line)).

## text

```cpp
const std::string& text() const
```

The whole content as one plain UTF-8 string: runs in order, paragraphs joined by `\n`. Every offset this class takes or returns indexes into it.

## length

```cpp
std::size_t length() const
```

Byte length of [text()](#text).

## run

```cpp
const TextLayoutRun& run(std::size_t index) const
```

Run `index` of the paragraphs' runs, flattened in order ([Fragment::run](#struct-fragment) indexes this).

## run_count

```cpp
std::size_t run_count() const
```

Number of runs across all paragraphs.

## start

```cpp
std::size_t start() const
```

The [`start`](#start) offset the last [layout()](#layout) was given; 0 unless this is an overflow continuation.

## fitting_lines

```cpp
std::size_t fitting_lines(float height) const
```

How many lines from the first fit whole in `height`: the lines a height-limited block shows before the rest overflows. May be 0.

## height_of

```cpp
float height_of(std::size_t count) const
```

The height the first `count` lines take, their paragraphs' margins included.

## hit_test

```cpp
std::size_t hit_test(Point p) const
```

The caret offset nearest `p` (layout coordinates): the line under it (the first above the text, the last below), then the nearer edge of the character under it.

## caret_rect

```cpp
Rect caret_rect(std::size_t offset) const
```

The caret at `offset`: a zero-width rect as tall as its line. An offset where a line wraps is drawn at the start of the next line.

## range_rects

```cpp
std::vector<Rect> range_rects(std::size_t begin, std::size_t end) const
```

The rects [begin, end) covers, one per line it touches.

## tag_at

```cpp
std::optional<std::size_t> tag_at(Point p) const
```

The tag of the run under `p`; unset when there is none or `p` is between runs.

## line_of

```cpp
std::size_t line_of(std::size_t offset) const
```

The index of the line holding `offset` (as [caret_rect()](#caret_rect) places it).

## offset_at_x

```cpp
std::size_t offset_at_x(std::size_t line, float x) const
```

The offset on line `line` nearest the horizontal position `x`.

## render

```cpp
void render(Renderer& renderer, Point origin, const Paint& paint) const
```

Draws the laid-out lines with their top-left at `origin`: highlight and selection backgrounds first, then the text (one draw_text() per run per line, one per word under Justify), then the recolored highlighted/selected text clipped to its range.

## struct Fragment

One drawn piece of a run on one line. [Rect](../core/rect.md) is relative to the layout's origin.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rect` | `Rect` |  | Bounds of the piece in layout coordinates (DIPs). |
| `run` | `std::size_t` | `0` | index into runs() (the paragraphs' runs, flattened) |
| `begin` | `std::size_t` | `0` | offsets into [text()](#struct-fragment) |
| `end` | `std::size_t` | `0` | one past the piece's last byte in [text()](#struct-fragment) |
| `text` | `std::string` |  | the piece's own text, as drawn |

## struct Line

One laid-out line: its box, its range of [text()](#text) and its range of [fragments()](#fragments).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `top` | `float` | `0.0f` | top edge in layout coordinates, margins included |
| `height` | `float` | `0.0f` | line box height in DIPs |
| `left` | `float` | `0.0f` | where the first fragment starts |
| `width` | `float` | `0.0f` | content width, a trailing space excluded |
| `begin` | `std::size_t` | `0` | offsets into [text()](#text): the line's characters |
| `end` | `std::size_t` | `0` | one past its last, a hard break's `\n` excluded |
| `next` | `std::size_t` | `0` | where the next line starts |
| `fragment_begin` | `std::size_t` | `0` | first index into [fragments()](#fragments) |
| `fragment_end` | `std::size_t` | `0` | one past the last index into [fragments()](#fragments) |
| `paragraph` | `std::size_t` | `0` | index into [content()](#content) |
| `hard_break` | `bool` | `false` | ended by `\n` or the paragraph's end |

## struct Paint

Per-draw state for [render()](#render): colors, the visible line window, highlights and selection.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `foreground` | `Color` |  | [Color](../core/color.md) of runs that don't set their own. |
| `first_line` | `std::size_t` | `0` | Only lines [first_line, last_line) are drawn, shifted up so first_line's top sits at the origin; an unset last_line draws to the end. This is how a block shows its part before an overflow takes over. |
| `last_line` | `std::optional<std::size_t>` |  |  |
| `highlights` | `std::span<const TextHighlight>` |  | Drawn under the selection, each background first, then its foreground over its text. A non-owning view; the highlights must outlive the [render()](#render) call. |
| `selection` | `std::optional<TextHighlight>` |  | The selection, drawn last over the highlights; unset draws none. |
| `colors` | `std::span<const TextColorSpan>` |  | Colors for ranges of the text, sorted by `begin` and not overlapping: the runs' text is drawn in pieces at their edges. Cheaper than foreground highlights for many ranges. A non-owning view; the spans must outlive the [render()](#render) call. |
| `tag_color` | `Callback<std::optional<Color>(std::size_t tag) const>` |  | Overrides a run's color by its tag (hyperlink hover and press); called for runs with a tag, and nullopt keeps the run's color. |
